atelier: He resented the intrusion of the children, who gaped with wondering eyes at him, sitting so stiff up there in their mother’s bright atelier.
Upon his arrival she began by introducing him to her atelier and making a sketch of him.

“It seems to me the utmost folly for a woman at the head of a household, and the mother of children, to spend in an atelier days which would be better employed contriving for the comfort of her family.”
Edna went up to her atelier—a bright room in the top of the house.
